name: Finding God
overview: Scripture reveals that finding God is a promise tied to wholehearted seeking and sincere devotion. The Lord assures that those who seek Him with all their heart and soul will indeed find Him, as emphasized in Deuteronomy 4:29 and Jeremiah 29:13. This pursuit involves actively seeking God's kingdom and righteousness first, as Matthew 6:33 encourages, and persistently asking, seeking, and knocking, with the assurance of receiving, finding, and having doors opened (Matthew 7:7). God’s loving invitation extends to those who call upon Him, promising to reveal profound and hidden truths (Jeremiah 33:3), demonstrating that a genuine relationship with God is accessible through earnest pursuit and trust.
